name: grp-mcp
description: Drive an Acumatica ERP instance from Claude: read, write, run processes and diagnose failures across the five APIs Acumatica actually has. Talks to your own instance directly - nothing is proxied, and credentials never leave your machine. Writes are off per profile until you enable them, and a clean 'ok' is never trusted: writes are read back and anything unconfirmed is reported as unverified. Runs on Windows, macOS and Linux from PyPI through uvx, so it needs uv installed - 'winget install astral-sh.uv' on Windows, 'brew install uv' on a Mac. Run tools\Edit-Connections.cmd once to create your connections file; it lands in %USERPROFILE%\grp-mcp (~/.grp-mcp on macOS and Linux), outside AppData where a Claude app update cannot delete it, and the server finds it with no environment variable set. LATEST (0.81.0-rc38): a publish or validation sent while another is running on the site is now reported as refused. The site turns it away inside an ordinary reply, and the tools used to wait on the running operation and report its result as their own - 'completed', not failed, with the other operation's log - so a publish that never ran looked done. A real publish also restarts the website partway through: the tools stopped checking at that point and showed 'in progress' forever, and since Acumatica finishes a publish only while something keeps checking on it, the publish could be left unfinished. They now keep checking through the restart, for up to three hours. Every request gets its own job, and a second one is refused while the first runs. Also: verifying a write with both a table and a filter no longer loses the record's key, and a table name given as 'Graph+DAC' is read correctly. Full history in docs/CHANGELOG.md.
